title: Handle a missing priority on POST /api/tickets instead of crashing
evidence: var/log/dev.log: ErrorException 'Undefined array key priority' TicketController.php:40 (x1)
observed: POST /api/tickets without a priority key triggers an uncaught warning and returns HTTP 500.
expected: No 500. The log gives no stated expectation. The spec-writer must define the contract: either a validation error (400/422), or a default priority. This overlaps with F1, which adds validation of allowed priority values, so the two should be specified together.
